scope: Facts about securities, not about any holder. Shared by every subject in the library.
evidence_standard: Each entry records what the resolution actually rests on. None of these come from an authoritative corporate-actions feed — that source does not exist in this project yet — so confidence reflects the strength of the available basis and never claims more.

entries.evidence: Issuer name continuity (MEDIA GEN INC -> MEDIA GEN INC NEW) across a single filing boundary, with position value within 30%. The 'NEW' suffix is the filer's own marker for a re-identified issuer. Reviewed by hand; not from a corporate-actions feed.

Share count moved 3.94x while position value moved 0.98x — arithmetically a split rather than a purchase, and the ratio rounds to a clean 4:1. Same CUSIP on both sides, which rules out re-identification. Reviewed by hand; not from a corporate-actions feed.
Issuer name continuity with an explicit share-class marker (CHARTER COMMUNICATIONS INC D -> INC N) and value within 2%. Reviewed by hand; not from a corporate-actions feed.
Issuer name continuity (LIBERTY GLOBAL PLC -> LIBERTY LATIN AMERICA LTD) with value within 3%, one-to-one across the boundary. Reviewed by hand; not from a corporate-actions feed.
Second share class of the same transition as G5480U138, matching one-to-one with value within 4%. Reviewed by hand; not from a corporate-actions feed.

Identical issuer name (NU HLDGS LTD) on both sides with value within 8% and a one-character CUSIP difference, which is the shape of an identifier correction rather than a trade. Reviewed by hand; not from a corporate-actions feed.

Same CUSIP, same issuer (LENNAR CORP), and an identical share count of 152,572 on both sides of the boundary — which then stays at 152,572 for the following five quarters. A position nobody touched, filed under a corrected class label. Reading it as an exit and an entry fabricates a full round trip. Stronger than the issuer-name-continuity entries above, because an unchanged share count is arithmetic rather than a name resemblance, but still hand review rather than a corporate-actions feed: note that 526057302 matches neither Lennar class CUSIP exactly, so the filer's identifier is questionable in a way this entry does not attempt to resolve. What it asserts is only that the position is continuous.

deliberately_unresolved.reason: Liberty Media recapitalised into multiple tracking stocks, so these are one-to-many transitions: 531229102 maps to BOTH 531229607 and 531229409, and the 2023 boundary splits again. SecurityLineage models a single successor and cannot represent that without either dropping a leg or double-counting a position. Resolving these needs a one-to-many lineage type and an authoritative source for the exchange ratios; asserting a 1:1 successor here would be inventing the very fact the table exists to record.

changes: Adds the share-class dimension. Entries may now name `from_title`/`to_title`; an entry that omits them applies to whichever classes the holder had under that CUSIP, which is what an issuer-level re-identification does. Every v1 entry omits them and is unchanged in effect. One entry is new: the Lennar class relabeling, which only became visible once identity included the share class.
